# apple_app_territory_availability (Resource)

Sets whether an app is sold in one territory, and when. The app needs an `apple_app_availability`; reference it in `app_id` so it's created first. Destroying the resource makes the app unavailable in the territory. Import it with `<app_id>/<territory>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_territories" "all" {}

# Sell the app everywhere.
resource "apple_app_territory_availability" "all" {
  for_each  = data.apple_territories.all.ids
  app_id    = apple_app_availability.example.app_id
  territory = each.key
  available = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app, e.g. `apple_app_availability.example.app_id`.
- `available` (Boolean) Whether the app is sold in the territory.
- `territory` (String) Territory, e.g. `USA`; see `data.apple_territories`.

### Optional

- `pre_order_enabled` (Boolean) Whether customers can pre-order the app before `release_date`, which must be in the future. End pre-orders early with `apple_end_pre_orders`. Defaults to `false`.
- `release_date` (String) Date the app is released in the territory, e.g. `2026-12-01`, for a release after approval or a pre-order. Ending a pre-order clears it.

### Read-Only

- `content_statuses` (Set of String) Statuses of the app in the territory, e.g. `AVAILABLE` or `CANNOT_SELL_RESTRICTED_RATING`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the territory availability.
- `pre_order_publish_date` (String) Date the pre-order was published on the App Store.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_territory_availability.all["USA"]
  identity = {
    app_id    = "1234567890"
    territory = "USA"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `territory` (String) Territory, e.g. `USA`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import 'apple_app_territory_availability.all["USA"]' 1234567890/USA
```
